text:
morgan: Heads up — seeing a handful of users still showing up as *owners* on groups after a scheduled SCIM deprovision ran this morning. Affected prefix: infra- and billing-team. :eyes:

devon: I see that too. SCIM job finished with 200s for member removals but owner attribute remains on the group object in the identity provider. Not all groups, ~7 so far.

julia: Any errors in the sync job? Which mapper version are we running on the private deploy for acme-corp?

devon: mapper v2.1.0 (the RBAC refactor rolled last week). Quick paste from the scim-worker logs:```
[2026-03-19T08:10:12Z] scim-worker: PATCH /Groups/00a1 - body={"members":[...]} - 200 OK
[2026-03-19T08:10:13Z] scim-worker: PATCH /Groups/00a1 - body={"owner":"removed-user-extid"} - 204 No Content
[2026-03-19T08:10:13Z] scim-worker: mapper: owner_attr_map not found for group 00a1, skipping
[2026-03-19T08:10:13Z] scim-worker: completed sync job id=sync-20260319-08:10
```

morgan: mapper: owner_attr_map not found? That sounds like the RBAC refactor changed attribute names and mapper isn't picking up legacy owner key. Could explain why member removals applied but owner mapping skipped.

security-bot: ALERT: KMS rotation completed 1830426000. Any syncs relying on encrypted ext_id fields must succeed decrypt or will skip attribute transforms.

julia: Good call. If mapper looks up an encrypted ext_id and fails decrypt, it might skip owner mapping. Can we confirm decrypt errors in the same log?

devon: Searching:```
[2026-03-19T08:09:58Z] scim-worker: decrypt-extid: decrypt failed: KMS.DecryptError: AccessDenied
[2026-03-19T08:09:58Z] scim-worker: mapper: fallback to unhashed_extid lookup
[2026-03-19T08:09:58Z] scim-worker: owner_attr_map not found for group 00a1, skipping
```

ops-sre: That KMS.DecryptError lines up with rotation window. Looks like the scim-worker role didn't have the new keypolicy attached in the private tenant. Ops will check IAM/KMS key policy.

morgan: Meanwhile, we need a mitigation — these remnant owners have elevated access. Can we add a one-off ACL reconcile to remove residual owner perms where extid was deprovisioned?

devon: I can patch scim-mapper to treat missing owner_attr_map as explicit remove for owner principal when members list is empty. Will push v2.1.1 to private and run a reconcile script: `tools/scim/reconcile --target infra-* --dry-run` first.

julia: Please include an audit log entry for every manual change and tag the ticket. Use audit key `SCIM-20260319-owner-lag`. Ops: confirm KMS policy fix before we re-run all tenant syncs.

ops-sre: On it — attaching IAM diff to the ticket. Early notes: missing kms:Decrypt for role arn:aws:iam::999999:role/scim-worker-private. Will patch and rekey. ETA 30m.

morgan: OK. Run the dry-run and post results. If reconcile looks good, proceed with live run after ops confirms KMS. I'll notify customer success for affected accounts and flag for audit. :warning:

devon: Dry-run output (started 1830429200):```
reconcile: scanned 9 groups, candidates for owner-removal=7
reconcile: sample change: group infra-kube -> remove owner extid:-user-123 (reason: extid deprovisioned)
reconcile: write-ops=0 (dry-run)
```

morgan: Looks like the right set. Hold on final until KMS fixed. Thanks everyone.

security-bot: NOTE: created ticket SEC-1247 (SCIM owner attr propagation lag) and linked logs.

ops-sre: KMS policy updated and rotation re-applied, running a small validation decrypt now.

devon: After KMS fix, mapper v2.1.1 pushed to private and a non-dry reconcile started 1830429300. Will post final status when complete.

morgan: Thanks — follow up after reconcile completes. If any owner removals fail, we'll escalate to oncall and run manual ACL audits. :thumbsup:
